2608.02295.title: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4
2608.02295.paper_summary: We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry.
2608.02295.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 MechGeo，一個 Mathlib 原生的自主框架，旨在共同解決歐幾里得幾何的忠實自動形式化和經過認證的證明構建。在這個框架中，GeoFormalizer 將非正式問題表示為 GeoIR，並確定性地將其翻譯成 Lean 4，並通過結構診斷和語義評估迭代修正候選陳述。GeoProver 構建幾何證明計劃，推導中間引理，並通過在 Lean 中驗證的庫選擇性地將適合的子目標代數化。Singular 或 SymPy 可能生成代數證明，但所有生成的證明和反例都由 Lean 的核心進行檢查。對七個 LLM 主幹的實驗顯示自動形式化有顯著改善，特別是對於直接翻譯性能較弱的模型。在 43 個歷史 IMO 幾何問題中，GeoFormalizer 生成的正式陳述在 29 個案例中被 GeoProver 證明；對於剩下的 14 個，它構建了在 Lean 中驗證的反例，並在專家修正後證明所有修正的陳述。連同 IMO 2026 問題 2，這在我們的知識範圍內，提供了針對 IMO 幾何問題的最大報告自動化、核心檢查的 Lean 證明集合。在 LEAP 的 Lean-IMO-Bench 中的 14 個幾何陳述中，MechGeo 首次證明了 12 個，正式駁斥了剩下的兩個，並證明了兩個修正的陳述。這些結果確立了以反例引導的診斷、幾何推理和經過認證的符號計算作為值得信賴的正式幾何的實用基礎。
